a:r.a:t: Methodology — The 9-Stage Pipeline
Informational estimate only — not medical or dietary advice.
Comprehensive end-to-end processing pipeline from initial photo capture to verifiable nutritional report
Stage
Primary Operation / Functionality
Architectural Invariant / Purpose
1. Input Intake
Accepts meal image, optional context (plate diameter, meal type, diet goals).
Captures user context to constrain portion estimation.
2. Image Preparation
Validates format, checks blur/lighting, assigns routing tier (T0, T1, T2).
Fails fast on unusable photos; matches pipeline depth to complexity.
3. Perception Agent
Detects visual components, bounding boxes, physical states, relative areas.
Strict rule: VLM emits labels and coordinates only; never calories or grams.
4. Food Analysis (RAG)
Dense + BM25 hybrid search over IFCT 2017 & USDA; state-filtered reranking.
Every number grounded in peer-reviewed composition tables (cutoff 0.55).
5. Portion Estimation
Plate scale anchor → projected area → heap volume → food density → grams.
Scale-anchored geometry converts 2D pixels to mass with 80% CI.
6. Nutrition Calculation
Scales per-100 g database nutrients by estimated mass; sums overall totals.
Pure Python arithmetic outside LLM; unit-tested; NULL values preserved.
7. Confidence Fusion
Fuses 7 pipeline signals into a single score; calibrated via isotonic regression.
Provides statistically honest uncertainty instead of uncalibrated confidence.
8. Decision & Clarify
Accepts result if confidence ≥ τ; triggers targeted question if confidence < τ.
Resolves biggest uncertainties cheaply; max 2 questions/round, 2 rounds.
9. Report & Guidance
Generates transparent report with values, ranges, sources, and diet tips.
Explains validated totals without modifying underlying numbers.
